verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents several natural-language surfaces. Users can ask questions about their business in plain English, connect Puzzle to Claude via MCP for natural-conversation access to financial data, run Accounting AI prompts on the general ledger (e.g., for PDF/CSV imports), and describe recurring busywork once to have it done automatically with review. All of this evidence is vendor-claimed, and much of it centers on querying rather than performing actions. Missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands can drive write actions broadly (invoices, journal entries, reconciliations), clarity on whether the MCP integration supports actions beyond reading data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
